title: 0.1.x: publish glyph through the OIDC Trusted Publisher route (provenance)
description: Follow-up to GCLI-46 AC8, not met for 0.1.0. Under DEC-299 (a3) 0.1.0 is published locally with a token and carries no npm provenance attestation. For 0.1.x: after the first publish exists, the operator configures the npmjs.com Trusted Publisher for @opum-ai/glyph (repository opum-ai/glyph-cli, workflow release.yml, environment release); then a release.yml dispatch with publish true against a v* tag publishes via OIDC, and the provenance line is read back as the AC8 evidence. Trusted Publisher configuration and the real dispatch are operator tier-3 steps, never agent steps.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the operator has configured the Trusted Publisher for @opum-ai/glyph (recorded by the operator)
a release.yml dispatch with publish true against a 0.1.x tag publishes by OIDC and the run id is recorded
the published version shows an npm provenance attestation (proof: npm view or the registry page provenance line)
